meta.title: About the Archive
meta.description: Learn about the fan-made Lara Croft Fans archive and its preservation mission.

aboutPage.title: A fan-made preservation chamber
aboutPage.description: Lara Croft Fans is a non-official project built to celebrate Tomb Raider history with care, atmosphere, and public access.

sections.title: Mission
sections.body: To gather Tomb Raider history into a fan archive that feels curated, explorable, and respectful of the franchise legacy.

sections.title: Vision
sections.body: To turn each public page into a different chamber: games as tablets, media as exhibits, and timelines as archaeological routes.

sections.title: Future Plans
sections.body: The archive is prepared for deeper game pages, character records, galleries, collectibles, guides, and fan community highlights.

preservation.title: Preserving the trail
preservation.description: This phase uses static content only, but the structure is ready for richer archive work.
preservation.body: The project does not claim ownership of Tomb Raider or Lara Croft. It exists as a fan-made celebration of discovery, design history, and the enduring appeal of exploring ancient spaces.
